# Servlead Solutions

> AI automation and efficiency consulting for owner-run businesses in the Lehigh Valley, PA (Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, and surrounding). Founder Sam Gorla does the work himself. Your business runs through your head. I help you fix that.

## Who it's for
- Owner-run Lehigh Valley businesses: contractors and trades, manufacturers (job shops, fabricators, small plants), and distributors (wholesale and supply houses); professional services (CPAs, law firms, insurance agencies, agencies); and healthcare practices (dental, PT, chiropractic, counseling), limited to scheduling, intake, and billing follow-up, never clinical or patient records.
- Trades, manufacturing, and distribution page: https://servleadsolutions.com/trades-manufacturing-distribution — Contractors are unnamed: estimating catalog and templates built for a Lehigh Valley GC (about 255 materials; addition, bath, and kitchen templates). Quote follow-up is designed, not built. Public contractor figures only: about $38K–$54K a year and about 8 hours per bid, both at a Lehigh Valley GC, and 11 of 24 leaks across six audits from two root causes. Manufacturing and distribution example is AIG Safety (Access Innovations Global), from a real AI & Efficiency Audit, not a finished build: safety-products manufacturer, dealer network of about 50 dealers, lean team. Orders entered by hand and shipping documents re-keyed because QuickBooks didn't connect to the carriers (about 6 hours a week). Dealer purchase orders in their own formats and part numbers; a mapping to the manufacturer's part numbers was designed, not built. Collections follow-up and inventory visibility were weak spots. Do not cite invoice amounts, other AIG dollar figures, deal pricing, or staff names.
- Professional services page: https://servleadsolutions.com/professional-services — owner-run CPA firms, law firms, insurance agencies, and agencies. Examples, not case studies: intake to an engagement letter, proposal and renewal follow-up, document-request chasing, and an internal knowledge base for procedures.

## What it costs
- Free 30-minute look: a free 30-minute look at one or two workflows. Phone, Teams, or in person in the Lehigh Valley. This is not the AI & Efficiency Audit. Book: https://cal.com/samgorla/quick-connect
- The 30-minute call ends with a clear next step, and it isn't always the AI & Efficiency Audit. Workflow Rebuild: one workflow rebuilt end to end, with AI where it earns its place, quoted after the call. e.g., a quote follow-up system, a company knowledge base, or an AI assistant that keeps the owner on top of the day. The AI & Efficiency Audit ($1,000): when the bigger picture needs finding. A straight answer: sometimes you don't need me. If it's simple, I'll tell you how to fix it yourself, or point you to someone who fits better.
- The AI & Efficiency Audit: $1,000. $500 to book, $500 when the written plan lands (within 48 hours). If I don't show you at least $10,000 a year leaking out of your business, audit is free. Book: https://cal.com/samgorla/consultation
- Plain pricing, same words as the site: The AI & Efficiency Audit is $1,000: $500 to book, $500 on delivery. If I don't show you at least $10,000 a year leaking out of your business, audit is free. Workflow Rebuilds are quoted after the free call.
- Bigger operation, $10M and up? I'll scope the AI & Efficiency Audit to the right department, or the whole company, on the 30-minute call.
